name: Heroku
line: Deploy and run apps on managed dynos with add-on services.

free.text: No ongoing free dyno, Postgres or key-value plan

work.math: $5 a month for the account. The full total for the static workload is unknown.
$50 a month at most per dyno (Heroku's name for an app container). It does not confirm the minimum of 1 vCPU and 1 GiB.
Up to $50 for compute + up to $50 for the database = up to $100 a month. Both are maximums, and daily backups are included.
